items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: I know Rip's very well and I know Webber, his right hand partner, because I used to play for all the big bands that came to their club

ctx.x: I don't remember ever doing anything for Rip Roberts. You know Rip Roberts- I did, he wasn't on the session. It must have been somebody else handling the session. Yeah that's possible. Because they know it was on Rip. Because I know Rip's very well and I know Webber, his right hand partner, because I used to play for all the big bands that came to their club which was low and low and low and low and low and low. And I know that's not a big band. I know that's not a big band. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I used…
Yeah. Rip had a club. What was the name of it? San Jacinto was the name of the club. San Jacinto? Yeah.
